Marissa / Rishi — assigning this to Legal intake. Quick notes on our side:
- Preferred sequencing: NDA first (confirm scope and confidentiality), then MSA (commercial + liability), then DPA (privacy) — DPA review can proceed in parallel if privacy clauses in MSA are minimal.
- Typical internal turnaround: NDA 48-72 hours for a standard mutual NDA with no unusual clauses; MSA 3-5 business days for standard redline; complex indemnity/controls takes longer (we'll flag).
- If they send a detailed redline set with substantive changes to limits/indemnities, plan for 7-10 business days.

As soon as we get Acme's MSA/nda, please drop in Legal intake (cc me) and attach the docx/pdf. If the redline is small, I'll handle directly; if it implicates security/compliance language, I'll loop Security.

Also, we prefer to receive vendor templates via DocuSign or as tracked changes in a docx. That helps speed the comparison.

Ben Carter
